sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('0d81315c-7021-4091-b703-ad135390c936', 'b6b97e41-5f15-498c-abfb-d8443ea4d216') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment
